entities.name: Johann Konrad Kern
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johann Konrad Kern was a Swiss statesman. He was the first president of the Federal Supreme Court (1848–1850) and president of the National Council in 1850–1851. Kernstrasse in Zürich is named for him.
